entities.name: Theophiliscus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Theophiliscus was the commander of the Rhodian quinquereme fleet at the Battle of Chios. The battle ended in a Rhodian and Pergamese victory but Theophiliscus died of wounds he received in the battle.
